description: ODC (coverage T): ANONYMOUS STRUCTURE and LIST TYPE, the two data types that no job names because the platform creates them on its own. Mirrors tests/jobs/aggregate-sum-calc.json: an aggregate with group by, Count aggregation and a calculated column returns rows of an ANONYMOUS STRUCTURE (IAnonymousStructure, via IESpace.GetOrCreateAnonymousStructure) - which is why GetX.List.Current.<Column> is read without the entity alias; and a variable and an output of type '<Structure> List' make the kernel ask for the LIST TYPE (IESpace.GetOrCreateListType) that did not yet exist in the module. In ODC the aggregate Count is Long Integer, so the target column is too.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio gives an error); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job

ops._why: the LIST TYPE is born here: the module did not yet have a list of this structure

ops.name: OpenCount
ops._why: DIFFERENT NAME from SS11: there the type is IAggregateAttribute, in ODC it is IAggregatedAttribute (the DisplayName 'Aggregate Attribute' is the same in both)

ops.name: ProjectLabel
ops._why: the calculated column enters the ICombineSourcesOperation, which runs BEFORE the group by: so it does NOT appear in the grouped row (reading GetTaskRollup.List.Current.ProjectLabel gives Error ExpressionUnknownObject) and the IGroupByOperation has no Create for it. The SS11 job (aggregate-sum-calc) also only reads the aggregated columns

allowForEach.why: a proof job written before the owner rule reached raw ops: the loop maps the rows into a list (T2), kept as written and listed

ops._why: WITH group by the column is read directly (ProjectId), without the alias WfCovTask.: it is the anonymous structure of the row
in ODC the aggregate Count is Long Integer, so OpenTasks is Long Integer

in ODC the ListAppend exists as an IClientActionSignature AND as an IServerActionSignature; 'IActionSignature:ListAppend' (the form from the SS11 job) hits the client one and the IExecuteServerActionNode refuses it
proves the output typed by the newly created LIST TYPE
proves the type of the aggregate Count: in ODC it is Long Integer, in SS11 it is Integer

proves the LIST TYPE: the structure is consumed by the local variable (record) AND by the output (list), and the list only exists because the kernel asked GetOrCreateListType for it in this job
